verdict.rationale: Lithic's Events API lets you register and manage webhook URLs, control event subscription secrets, replay webhook messages, and search past events. It uses HMAC-signed headers, and the sandbox runs webhooks end-to-end, so these are documented, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation detail on the event-type catalog and per-event subscription filtering.
